description: This file declares the SSLClientSocket class and related classes for managing SSL connections, including configuration, context, and socket creation within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: SSLClientSocket
classes.description: A client socket that uses SSL as the transport layer, handling SSL handshake and connection retries.

classes.name: SSLClientContext
classes.description: Shared state and configuration for multiple SSLClientSockets, including SSL configuration, certificate management, and observers.

classes.name: SSLClientContext::Observer
classes.description: Interface for observing changes in SSL configuration and server-specific SSL settings.

methods.name: GetECHRetryConfigs
methods.description: Returns serialized ECH retry configurations after an error during handshake.

methods.name: SetSSLKeyLogger
methods.description: Sets the SSL key logger for capturing SSL key material.

methods.name: SerializeNextProtos
methods.description: Serializes Next Protocols for ALPN in wire format.

methods.name: SSLClientContext
methods.description: Constructor for SSLClientContext with configuration parameters.

methods.name: CreateSSLClientSocket
methods.description: Creates a new SSLClientSocket for a given stream socket and configuration.

methods.name: GetClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves the client certificate and key for a server if configured.

methods.name: SetClientCertificate
methods.description: Sets the client certificate and key for a specific server.

methods.name: ClearClientCertificate
methods.description: Removes the client certificate preference for a server.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for SSL configuration changes.

methods.name: OnSSLContextConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in SSL context configuration.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the certificate verifier.

methods.name: OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the certificate database.
